responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s hierarchical logging subsystem. This file defines the reference-counted logger that writes indented, pretty-printer-based trace output to a FILE, including scope entry/exit tracking, formatted partial lines, flush-on-line semantics for crash-friendly logs, and the log_user support that lets analyzer objects share and manage logger lifetimes.
same_name_distinction: Implements logger and log_user behavior, including formatted output, indentation, scope enter/exit handling, flushing, and reference-count lifetime management. Unlike analyzer-logging.h, this file provides the runtime mechanics behind the logging API and macros.
